scope: Read-only market-data and persisted-ledger exposure audit. No production code, test, order, process, ledger, or lock changes.
limitations: A candle OHLC range is not a tick path, execution, or proof of an exit.
Due-time PnL cases are conditional on the ETH position remaining open through the scheduled risk checks; they are hypothetical marks only.
This audit does not infer why the owner stopped updating, establish causality, or promote profitability evidence.

marketData.provider: Upbit public REST API via repository src/api/upbit.js UpbitAPI
marketData.credentials: empty public-read client; no authenticated endpoint

timing.deadlineInterpretation: Configured 30-minute maximum hold is due at 15:59:10.198Z. The recorded losing-hold, break-even trigger, trailing activation, and winner-extension timers are zero/disabled, so no enabled configured modifier extends that deadline. This does not prove an execution or owner-side exit check occurred.

candleCoverage.missingMinuteInterpretation: No missing minutes in the requested post-heartbeat grid; gaps must be reported as incomplete coverage, never interpreted as quiet/no threshold touch.

heartbeatBoundaryCandle.interpretation: This minute contains the 15:52:20.080Z heartbeat and is timing-ambiguous. Its full low/high range stays between the risk thresholds, ruling out either threshold touch within this minute. It is kept separate from the full-minute post-heartbeat grid.

positionEntryMinute.timingQualification: Entry occurs at :10.198; OHLC cannot identify the exact intraminute path, but neither threshold is in the full-minute range.

scheduledDeadlineMinute.timingQualification: The scheduled deadline is 15:59:10.198Z inside this candle. Its OHLC is a range bound; its 16:00 close is not a due-time fill.

riskThresholdTouchAudit.scopeNote: No sampled post-entry bar range touched either configured threshold. This is market-path observation only, not proof of intrabar ordering, no execution, or the cause of the stale active ledger.

costModel.feeOnlyNetKrw: grossPnl - feeRate*(entryPrice+exitMark)*quantity; fee charged once per side
costModel.feeAndSlippageNetKrw: feeOnlyNet - slippageRate*(entryPrice+exitMark)*quantity; configured 0.1% slippage charged once per side
costModel.executionStatus: hypothetical marks only; no real fill observed or asserted

scheduledDeadlineCandle.qualification: Conditional counterfactual if the position remained open until the scheduled deadline. Candle low/high bound possible prices during the minute; neither is an observed fill or a known 15:59:10.198Z price. The 15:59 bucket finalizes at 16:00Z; its close is the candle's final trade price, not a trade asserted at exactly 16:00Z, and is shown only as a later mark.

latestCompletedCandle.qualification: Mark-to-close scenario only; not an observed fill, current-owner action, or addition to the recorded ten-trade net.

hypotheticalMarks.recordedPerformanceSeparation: The fee/slippage scenarios above are not added to the persisted 10-trade net of -3638.994884541925 KRW.
